dataset.name: Mont Blanc tunnel toll
dataset.method: Tunnel du Mont Blanc (TMB-GEIE): ATMB's prices for heavy vehicles from 2024-01-01, one way, France to Italy, EUR including 20% VAT, here excluding it; class 3 (two axles) and 4 (three or more). The Italy to France price is the same before Italy's 22% VAT. Goods vehicles over 3.5 t of EURO 0 to 4 aren't admitted. Rebuilt from the Internet Archive's copies of these pages (2024).
